# ledger_merchants (Data Source)

Lists Ledger merchants, in identifier order. Merchant routes need an API token with the administrator-only `merchants:read` and `merchants:write` grants (merchant names derive from bank text).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Active merchants; set include_archived = true to list archived and merged ones too.
data "ledger_merchants" "all" {
  include_archived = true
}

output "merchant_names" {
  value = [for m in data.ledger_merchants.all.items : m.display_name]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `include_archived` (Boolean) List archived and merged merchants too. Only active merchants are listed when unset or `false` (the API has no archived-only filter).

### Read-Only

- `items` (Attributes List) The merchants. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))

<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `aliases` (Attributes List) The alias names transactions are matched by. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--aliases))
- `archived` (Boolean) Whether it is archived (a merged merchant is archived).
- `archived_at` (String) When it was archived (RFC 3339, UTC), or null.
- `created_at` (String) When it was created (RFC 3339, UTC).
- `display_name` (String) The name shown for the merchant.
- `id` (String) The Ledger identifier.
- `merged_into` (String) The identifier of the merchant it was merged into, or null.
- `updated_at` (String) When it last changed (RFC 3339, UTC).
- `version` (Number) The optimistic-concurrency version.

<a id="nestedatt--items--aliases"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items.aliases`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) When it was added (RFC 3339, UTC).
- `id` (String) The alias identifier.
- `key` (String) The name as matched: NFC, white space collapsed, lower case.
- `name` (String) The alias name.
- `origin` (String) `user`, `decision` or `upgrade`.
